headlines.title: Stocks lost $2 trillion. The market is wrong about AI
headlines.summary: The stock market lost $2 trillion in 40 minutes, and AI stocks took the worst of it, with Intel down more than half since October and AMD off 17% in a day. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why it happened and why he thinks the market is wrong, from GPU rental prices up 106% to the CPU boom and Anthropic's IPO valuation.

headlines.title: Intel's stock crash shares an uncanny resemblance to its 2000 bust
headlines.summary: Intel stock's 26-year comeback and subsequent reckoning this year carry an eerie echo of its dot-com days.

headlines.summary: The fund's $513.3 million in gross trading was entirely buys, lifting 28 positions with no decreases.

headlines.title: Intel (INTC) Brings Hardware Backed Security To EdgeAI And Sharpens Xeon AI Case
headlines.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS:INTC) is supplying hardware-backed security for Atsign’s new EdgeAI platform for AI and IoT networking in 2026. Atsign’s EdgeAI offering uses Intel technology to combine high-throughput data handling with encrypted, device-level protection at the network edge. Symbolic Mind has reported efficiency gains in AI training and inference using Intel Xeon processors for on-premise enterprise workloads.

headlines.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 5: Intel Falls on Weak Fourth-Quarter Sales Outlook Amid Chip Selloff
headlines.summary: On Nov. 5, 2026, Intel's shares tumbled as a soft revenue forecast for the coming quarter rattled investors already wary of chip-sector weakness.

description: Intel Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and services computing and related end products and services in the United States, Ireland, Israel, and internationally. It operates through three segments: CCG, DCAI, and Intel Foundry. The company offers client computing group products, including client and commercial CPUs, discrete client GPUs, edge computing, and connectivity products; data center and AI products, such as server CPUs, discrete GPUs, and networking products; and semiconductors comprising wafer fabrication, substrates, and other related products and services. It also provides driving assistance and self-driving solutions; and develops and manufactures multi-beam mask writing tools. The company sells its products through sales organizations, distributors, resellers, retailers, and OEM partners. It serves original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers, cloud service providers, and other manufacturers and service providers. Intel Corporation has a strategic collaboration with Infosys Limited to develop a multi-layer AI fabric that unifies infrastructure, models, data, applications, and workflows into a composable and agent-ready ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
